title: A register TASK with no board row is adopted from the TASK, at revision 1, idempotently
requirement: REQ-136 (also REQ-138): a TASK whose boardId has no row on the board is reported with the fields needed to adopt it, and with --write the row is created again from the TASK at revision 1 through the board journal and lock; a second run writes nothing and the owner can change that status in the panel.
reason: The behaviour is a maintenance script against a live ledger; the only test path would be plugins/taskboard/test/, which is outside this task scope, and the decisive run mutates a board.
steps: Copy .dsh/ and state/ of the workspace into a disposable tree.
node scripts/taskboard-adopt.mjs --cwd <copy> lists every register TASK whose boardId has no row, with boardId, status, owner, role, dependsOn and title, and writes nothing.
node scripts/taskboard-adopt.mjs --cwd <copy> --write --only-open creates the rows of the tasks whose work is not over.
Run the list again and the write again: both report nothing left to adopt and the ledger revision does not move.
Run the panel flow (get -> owner-status) for TASK-383, TASK-372 and TASK-337 on the same copy.
expected: The report names 3 open-work tasks (TASK-337 review, TASK-372 blocked, TASK-383 active) among 383 TASKs without a row; the write appends them at revision+1 with revision 1 per row; the second write appends nothing; each of the three then changes status (revision 1 -> 2) and the TASK file follows. Finished tasks stay without a row unless --write runs without --only-open.
